facts.fact: Telecoms minister Mário Oliveira states in an ANGOP op-ed that WACS links Angola to the west African coast and Europe and SACS links Luanda to Fortaleza, Brazil, together reducing dependence on a single international route; two routes in service, WACS landing station not named.
Minister Mário Oliveira says SACS was put into operation in 2018 as the first direct high-capacity submarine link between Africa and South America, joining Luanda to Fortaleza in Brazil.

Minister Mário Oliveira states WACS ensures Angola's link to the west African coast and Europe, as a fundamental route to major international data centres; no landing station named, date is the op-ed's.

The minister describes 2Africa, which Angola has joined, as the largest open-access submarine system in the world (about 45,000 km); the text does not say which landing station or whether it is yet carrying Angolan traffic.
